method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: S&P 500 ends higher as traders shift from AI to healthcare
Equities.reason: Market-wide rotation: investors moving out of AI/tech into healthcare led the S&P to finish higher — indicates breadth improvement despite sector stress and points to a regime of sector rotation rather than broad risk-on.

Equities.title: US chip stocks set to wipe out $2 trillion after latest selloff
Equities.reason: Large-cap semiconductor rout is a major negative for the market narrative (AI/semis leadership under pressure). The potential $2tn market-cap loss is highly market-relevant and amplifies downside risk for growth/AI exposure.

Equities.title: The data centre IPO debacle that sparked a market meltdown
Equities.summary: Decisions by Australian groups Firmus and AirTrunk have added to concerns about the AI borrowing frenzy
Equities.reason: Signals systemic stress in the AI/data-centre funding complex — reinforces market concerns about leveraged capital supporting AI growth; material for equity sentiment and sector re-pricing.

Equities.title: Analysts react to Coreweave debt woes, AI selloff
Equities.reason: Analyst commentary on CoreWeave’s debt stress underscores contagion risk from AI-focused leverage; a relevant negative signal for AI/infra equities and credit-sensitive parts of the market.

Equities.title: Stocks, Futures Rise as Fed Bets Ease After Warsh: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Macro liquidity/interest-rate channel: easing of hawkish Fed expectations (after Warsh remarks) supports a rally in stocks and futures — positive for broad equities and offsets some sector-specific weakness.

Equities.title: Traders pile into bonds and defensive stocks as ‘tech wreck’ picks up steam
Equities.reason: Risk-off rotation: flow into bonds and defensives highlights growing aversion to tech risk and supports the narrative of market participants seeking safety amid the AI/tech selloff.

Equities.title: Nvidia-Backed AI Biotech Iambic Up 16% After $150 Million IPO
Equities.reason: Idiosyncratic positive for AI-enabled IPO activity and AI leadership — shows pockets of successful AI-related equity demand, but limited relevance to the broader negative tech/debt narrative.

Equities.title: Harvard’s endowment jumps 27% in fiscal 2026, lifted by SpaceX as top holding
Equities.reason: Positive signal for private-market/AI/space winners fueling outsized returns — supports the narrative that select large winners (SpaceX/AI) remain strong, but limited market breadth impact.

Rates.title: Fed's Warsh withholds rate signal, praises recent global tightening with 'no free riders'
Rates.summary: Warsh refrained from signaling another interest rate hike this month, pointed to a "synchronous tightening" by central banks in the fight against inflation.
Rates.reason: Warsh's decision not to explicitly signal an imminent hike reduces near-term Fed-hike odds and is modestly supportive for bond prices (yields down). Relevance is medium — high-profile Fed comment but not a firm policy pivot.

Rates.title: Dollar weakens as Fed’s Warsh declines to hint at October rate rise
Rates.summary: Comments at IMF meetings come after inflation data raised bets of possible back-to-back rate rises
Rates.reason: Market reaction — weaker dollar and headlines that Warsh declined to telegraph an October hike — implies fading near-term Fed tightening expectations and a bond rally (yields lower). High relevance given FT coverage and observable FX/yield moves.

Rates.title: Economists: Hot PPI shows Fed's work is not done
Rates.summary: 'We see real risks the Fed will deliver another rate hike in two weeks' time,' one Fedwatcher warns
Rates.reason: Hot PPI pushes up visible odds of additional Fed hikes, a clear negative for bond prices (yields higher). High relevance because inflation prints directly re-price policy expectations and the yield curve.

Rates.title: AI trade rout sparks flight to Treasurys, bond yields sink
Rates.reason: Risk-off selling in equity/AI positions driving a flight-to-quality into Treasurys, causing yields to fall — a strong, market-moving bond-price bid. High relevance as it describes actual flow-driven yield moves.

Rates.title: Investors dump data centre bonds as AI borrowers face ‘Darwin moment’
Rates.summary: Debt issued by AI infrastructure providers and neocloud companies such as CoreWeave has sunk to increasingly stressed levels
Rates.reason: Stress and widening yields in the corporate/data-centre bond segment increases credit risk premia and funding stress — negative for corporate bond markets. Relevance is medium as it signals spillovers and potential liquidity/stress in credit markets.

Rates.title: Wall Street on Alert for Bessent to Act on Bond Yields Again
Rates.reason: Market attention on a big-player potentially intervening/buying in bond markets can cap yields and provide episodic support to Treasurys. Relevance is modest — market-structure/flow story rather than a policy change.

Rates.title: ‘Early days’ to see full effect of energy prices on inflation, BoE’s Bailey says
Rates.summary: Lengthy period of higher costs would squeeze corporate margins and spur some companies to raise prices
Rates.reason: BoE commentary highlighting the risk that sustained energy costs translate into second-round inflation pressures increases the chance of further tightening — negative for bond prices (yields up). Relevance is medium as it signals inflation persistence risk.

Rates.title: Mortgage Rates Hover at 7.4%, Highest Since 2023
Rates.reason: Elevated mortgage rates reflect higher long-term interest rates and tighter financial conditions, which is negative for bond prices (higher yields). Relevance is moderate — important for the consumer/funding channel but more descriptive than policy-moving.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index extends decline to near 101.80 after Fed Warsh’s remarks
FX.summary: The US Dollar (USD) delivers a negative reaction after remarks from Federal Reserve (Fed) Chair Kevin Warsh at the Fireside Chat with International Monetary Fund (IMF) Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva.
FX.reason: Broad USD index weakness after Fed Chair remarks is a high-relevance, cross-currency signal driving dollar depreciation and USD-funded flows; strong implication for FX pairs.

FX.title: Euro gains as US Dollar weakens following Fed Warsh’s comments at IMF chat
FX.summary: EUR/USD remains stronger after posting modest gains the previous day, trading around 1.1230 during Asian hours on Friday. The currency pair inches higher as the US Dollar (USD) declines following recent comments from key financial leaders.
FX.reason: EURUSD strength is directly tied to the broader dollar pullback after Fed remarks; relevant for EUR/USD flows and euro positioning.

FX.title: British Pound gathers strength to near 1.3300 on Fed policy uncertainty
FX.summary: The GBP/USD pair gains traction to around 1.3300 during the early European trading hours on Friday. The British Pound (GBP) edges higher against the US Dollar (USD) amid hawkish remarks from Bank of England (BoE) Governor Andrew Bailey and stronger UK Gross Do
FX.reason: GBP gains against USD reflect both BoE comments and USD softness; meaningful for GBPUSD flows but more single-currency focused than index moves.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar stands firm near two-week high vs weak USD amid bullish oil prices
FX.summary: The USD/CAD pair remains under some selling pressure for the second straight day on Friday, trading around the 1.4175-1.4170 region during the Asian session and close to an over two-week low set the previous day.
FX.reason: CAD strength is a USD-weakness play amplified by bullish oil; relevant for USD/CAD but partially commodity-driven (lower relevance than pure USD-index moves).

FX.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: 157.50 pivotal support holds after Warsh's remarks
FX.summary: The USD/JPY pair fades an Asian session uptick to the 158.15-158.20 region, sliding back below the 158.00 mark following Federal Reserve (Fed) Chair Kevin Warsh's opening remarks at the Annual Meetings of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank Group, i
FX.reason: USD/JPY reaction to Fed remarks implies JPY strength and lower USD; important for carry/yield-driven flows and Japan intervention watch.

FX.title: US Treasury Official says Japan no longer faces deflation, Yen and monetary policy must adjust
FX.summary: US Treasury Undersecretary for International ‌Affairs, Erin Browne, said on Friday that Japan is no longer faces deflationary environment, and the Japanese Yen (JPY) level and monetary policy must change along with that.
FX.reason: Official US commentary increasing the case for BOJ policy adjustment supports medium-term JPY strength; relevant to FX regime expectations.

FX.title: Dollar Wraps Its Worst Day in Over a Month on AI Risk Concerns
FX.reason: Broad-market Bloomberg piece attributing USD weakness to AI risk concerns is a cross-asset driver that amplifies dollar selling and risk flow into FX markets.

FX.title: Indian Rupee gains for fifth straight day against US Dollar
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) continues to outperform the US Dollar (USD) on the back of weakness in the Greenback and forceful Reserve Bank of India’s (RBI) measures to curb the US Dollar’s demand by Oil Marketing Companies (OMCs).
FX.reason: INR gains reflect broader USD softness plus domestic RBI measures; relevant for EMFX flows but lower-impact versus G10/USD-index moves.

FX.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Holds steady below 177.50, bearish technicals reinforce downside bias
FX.summary: The EUR/JPY cross trades on a flat note around 177.30 during the early European trading hours on Friday. Traders remain on high alert for currency intervention from Japanese authorities to prop up the Japanese Yen (JPY).
FX.reason: Non-USD cross flagged due to explicit intervention risk—qualifies for inclusion as it signals potential policy action that would reverberate across FX markets.

Commodities.title: Gold attracts some buyers as USD hits two-week low after Warsh's neutral remarks
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) turns positive for the second straight day after a modest Asian session dip, extending its recovery from the weekly trough touched on Wednesday.
Commodities.reason: FXStreet reports renewed buyer interest in gold as the USD softens — direct XAU/USD price movement and safe-haven demand. This is a price/technical-led piece (cap relevance at 0.8) that supports a modest bullish signal for precious metals.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD rises above $57.50 amid safe-haven demand
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) extends its gains for the second consecutive day, trading around $57.80 per troy ounce during Asian hours on Friday. Silver prices advanced as a sharp selloff in equity markets triggered renewed safe-haven demand for precious metals.
Commodities.reason: Silver is moving higher on safe-haven flows after equity weakness. This is a price/forecast piece (price-technical relevance cap 0.8) indicating modest bullish momentum for precious metals.

Commodities.title: WTI Price Forecast: Holds above $95.50, remains close to multi-week top amid bullish setup
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – edges lower during the Asian session on Friday, trading as it holds above mid-$95.00s and remains close to a nearly four-week high, touched the previous day.
Commodities.reason: FXStreet technical/price note showing WTI holding near multi-week highs—price/forecast story with limited structural detail so capped relevance (0.8) but signals continued bullish oil price setup.

Commodities.title: IEA Agrees to Release of Outstanding 100 Million Oil Barrels
Commodities.reason: Bloomberg reports a coordinated release of 100m barrels from IEA stocks — a material one-off supply increase that tends to weigh on oil prices and risk premia. High relevance due to scale; direction negative for oil.

Commodities.title: Zijin Halts Processing at Copper-Zinc Mine Due to Fuel Shortage
Commodities.reason: Bloomberg reports a production halt at a copper-zinc mine from fuel shortages — a direct supply disruption for copper that supports higher prices. Elevated relevance because it is a tangible output cut.

Commodities.title: Category 2 Hurricane Isaias nears landfall, leading to production shut-ins
Commodities.summary: As of 4:00 a.m. central time on October 9, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration expects Hurricane Isaias to make landfall on the Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday, creating the potential for significant disruptions to energy infrastructur
Commodities.reason: EIA notes hurricane-driven production shut-ins in Gulf of Mexico regions — clear short-term supply disruption for US oil and gas, supporting higher prices. High relevance due to direct impact on production infrastructure.

Commodities.title: Iran ramps up attacks on shipping in Strait of Hormuz
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical escalation affecting shipping through the Strait of Hormuz raises oil risk premia and supply-disruption concerns. Relevant for oil prices and market risk sentiment; moderate-high relevance.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin recovers to $82k but set for second week in red
Crypto.reason: Short-term BTC price weakness/negative momentum. Price-movement headlines are market-signal but treated as technical/near-term so relevance capped (<=0.8).

Crypto.title: Nearly $1 billion in crypto bets liquidated as bitcoin, ether and XRP slide
Crypto.reason: Large cross-market forced liquidations indicate deleveraging and short-term liquidity stress across major crypto assets — significant negative for risk appetite and funding dynamics.

Crypto.title: BlackRock's crypto ETF assets surge 63% but remain far below 2025 peak
Crypto.reason: Institutional ETF inflows remain a dominant structural positive for crypto liquidity and price discovery; surge signals renewed demand though still below prior peak, so positive but tempered.

Crypto.title: Binance.US Seeks $100 Million to Expand Its Crypto Business
Crypto.reason: Capital raise aimed at U.S. business expansion points to investor support and growth of regulated onshore trading capacity — modest positive for market structure and flows.

Crypto.title: Kraken parent Payward to become first crypto firm to buy a EU bank as it expands into deposits, lending
Crypto.reason: Major institutionalization milestone: crypto firm acquiring a regulated EU bank materially expands deposit/lending rails and credibility. Structural positive for institutional adoption and crypto-financial integration.

Crypto.title: At the White House, crypto policy vacancy looms large
Crypto.reason: Regulatory leadership gap increases policy uncertainty in the U.S., a negative for institutional planning and cross-border regulatory clarity — meaningful downside to risk appetite.

Crypto.title: Crypto for Advisors: Wall Street is done waiting on Congress for crypto rules
Crypto.reason: Trend of institutional market participants building around existing regulatory frameworks rather than waiting for Congress supports ongoing institutional adoption and product development — constructive for flows.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin mining pool once handling 2.3% of network shuts after hashrate falls 65%
Crypto.reason: Miner stress and hashrate volatility can undermine network health and signal economic pressure in the mining cohort — modest negative for market confidence in the mining sector.

Crypto.title: Altcoins lead crypto declines as Asian stocks drop; bitcoin little changed since midnight
Crypto.reason: Breadth weakness with altcoins underperforming during risk-off moves signals narrower market leadership and weaker risk-on flows — negative for crypto market breadth.

Crypto.title: An OpenAI agent ran out of Ethereum funds, and took from a wallet it did not own
Crypto.reason: Automation/AI interacting with on-chain funds creates new operational/security risk vectors; negative for trust in automated payment/agent integrations, limited but real technical risk.

Crypto.title: AI agents make 138 million crypto payments as U.S. dominates spending on AI models
Crypto.reason: High volume of AI-driven crypto payments signals real-world utility and adoption of crypto rails by new use cases — structural positive for transaction demand and on-chain activity.

Crypto.title: How Brooklyn prosecutors and the FBI took down a massive crypto fraud network targeting Russian speakers
Crypto.reason: Enforcement action removes malicious actors and can improve long-run market credibility and institutional comfort; modest positive for market trust.

Crypto.title: Australia’s financial watchdog seeks stiffer rules for crypto exchanges ahead of licensing deadline
Crypto.reason: Tighter exchange rules increase near-term compliance burden and potential operational costs for platforms — negative near-term but could raise long-term standards; scored as near-term negative.

Crypto.title: Under pressure, Ledger unveils plan to turn its crypto hardware wallet into a smartphone
Crypto.reason: Product innovation aimed at improving user experience and security could broaden retail adoption; positive but incremental and product-level (lower relevance).
